Today while having coffee in the morning, my phone pinged, and a friend sent me a picture on WhatsApp, saying "picture of the day."

​It was an illustration showing a crowded street full of people walking around, completely glued to glowing smartphone screens. But sitting quietly on a bench nearby were two robots. One of them was reading a physical book and the other drawing a flower. The text at the top simply read: "Humans are hooked. Machines are learning."
